value.rationale: A natural distributional property of the central statistic in the probabilistic parking model is resolved for all parameters. It identifies a whole qualitative phase diagram, universal logistic outer thresholds, a countable boundary staircase and a distinct sharp location transition at scale 1/n. This goes beyond a mean, a sample histogram, or a parameter-picked numerical invariant.
